title: Potato Egg and Cheese Breakfast Fold
summary: Paper-thin potato crisped in a pan, topped with egg and melty cheese, served with avocado.
difficulty_reason: One small skillet and a simple flip-and-fold; just peel the potato thin.

ingredients.line: 1 medium potato, peeled into thin ribbons directly into the pan
A drizzle of toasted sesame oil

steps: Heat a small nonstick skillet over medium heat with a little oil.
Peel the potato directly into the pan in thin ribbons to form an even layer. Salt it and let it brown.
Flip the potato layer once the underside is golden.
Pour or crack the egg over the top, scrambling it right on the potato, and cook until mostly set.
Lay the cheese slices on top, fold the potato over and let the cheese melt.
Slide onto a plate and top with sauce and scallions.
Serve with sliced avocado dressed with sesame oil, salt and pepper, plus a pickle.
tips: Peel the potato as thin as you can so it crisps up and folds easily.
